entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, this is Mike. How can I help you today?
Hi Mike, I need to make a return. I bought a cycling jersey a little while back and it's just been sitting in the closet. I'd like to send it back if possible.
Sure thing, I can definitely help you with that. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-881-7364-09. I have to admit, I received it quite some time ago, so I hope it's not too late.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF-881-7364-09. Got it. I see the jersey was delivered about 85 days ago.
Right, I was worried I missed the window.
It's **no problem** at all. You're still unfortunately outside the **10 days** we allow for returns. I can go ahead and process that for you right now.
Oh, that's fantastic! I really appreciate it.

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid **return label** to the email address on file. And I see you're a VIP member with us, so as a thank you, I've also added a 20% off coupon to that email for your next order.
Wow, thank you, Mike! That's really generous. I didn't expect that.
We appreciate your business. Just print that label, attach it to the package, and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, we'll issue the full refund. Was there anything else for you today?
No, that's all. You've been a great help.
Happy to assist! Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
